head: Sidewalk Joy map app: find free little art galleries and swaps near you
dek: Sidewalk Joy is a free iPhone and iPad app with a worldwide map of free street exchanges, such as little art galleries, trinket swaps, mug exchanges, puzzle libraries and seed swaps. It came out on 24 November and was #79 among free Navigation apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: You can search spots by name or neighborhood, mark them as want to visit or already visited, save favorites and plan a route between them. Wishing trees and plant exchanges are on the map too. The app is made by Sidewalk Joy LLC and needs iOS 17 or later.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later), App Store, free
means: If you like walks with a small surprise on the way, the app shows free exchange spots around you and lets you plan a route past them.
todo: Search "Sidewalk Joy" in the App Store and look up your neighborhood on the map.
thumb_words: SIDEWALK JOY: FREE SPOTS NEAR YOU
